simpleores.guide.page.1.title: Simple Ores
simpleores.guide.page.1: Silver ore in the Overworld and the End, and rose gold: two alloys of gold, copper and silver, pressed into bundles, smelted in the blast furnace only, with tools and armor of their own.
simpleores.guide.page.2.title: Silver
simpleores.guide.page.2: A pale metal found in the Overworld and the End. It is rarer than gold and not a tool material: it is an ingredient (rose gold) and a building metal.
simpleores.guide.page.3.title: Rose gold
simpleores.guide.page.3: Two alloys of gold, copper and silver: hard Rose Bronze (about 585) and soft Blossom Gold (about 750). Made in two steps: press ingots into pressings, melt them in a blast furnace.
simpleores.guide.page.4.title: Rose gold tools and armor
simpleores.guide.page.4: Sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and a full armor set of each alloy. Both mine like iron; neither beats diamond.
simpleores.guide.page.5.title: Settings
simpleores.guide.page.5: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simpleores.start.title: Welcome to Simple Ores
quests.simpleores.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpleores.start.welcome.title: A free guide
quests.simpleores.start.welcome.descript: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Ores Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and raw gold.
